locative expressing the circumstance or condition
verb of speaking introducing the prescribed formula
compound denoting one who has mastered the senses
compound indicating continuation of the cited formula

items.question: What utterance is prescribed for the sense-conquered practitioner when expectation arises?
premises: A condition of expectation may arise in the ritual context.
A specific verbal formula is prescribed for that condition.
The sense-conquered authority declares this prescribed utterance.
items.inference: When expectation arises, the sense-conquered practitioner should utter the prescribed formula.
uncertainties: The exact content of the formula abbreviated by ityādi is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: In case of expectation, the sense-conquered one says: one should say thus, and so forth.
